evidence: Matches the 'Scripts and tools' label and adds a standalone utility script under contrib/multisig/.
rationale: Adds a standalone CLI wizard to coordinate multisig descriptor wallet setup across participants using existing RPCs. While it addresses a well-known user pain point regarding manual multisig construction and directly touches keys and descriptors, as a contrib helper intended largely to prototype and guide upcoming core wallet RPC workflows (#35645), review is worthwhile but reasonably deferrable.
